ਪਉੜੀ ੫
paurree 5
ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਸਚੁ, ਸਚੇ ਭਾਇਆ ।
kevadd aakhaa sach, sache bhaaeaa |
Flow great is the'truth that it is liked by that true One (God).
ਕੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਆ ਪਉਣੁ, ਫਿਰੈ ਚਉਵਾਇਆ ।
kevadd hoaa paun, firai chauvaaeaa |
How vast is the air that moves in all the four directions.
ਚੰਦਣ ਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ, ਬਿਰਖ ਬੋਹਾਇਆ ।
chandan vaas nivaas, birakh bohaaeaa |
Fragrance is placed in sandal which makes other trees also fragrant.
ਖਹਿ ਖਹਿ ਵੰਸੁ ਗਵਾਇ, ਵਾਂਸੁ ਜਲਾਇਆ ।
kheh kheh vans gavaae, vaans jalaaeaa |
Bamboos burn by their own friction and destroy their own abode.
ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਸਹਲੰਗੁ, ਅੰਗੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ ।
siv sakatee sehalang, ang janaaeaa |
The forms of the bodies have become visible y the association of Siva and Sakti.
ਕੋਇਲ ਕਾਉ ਨਿਆਉ, ਬਚਨ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
koeil kaau niaau, bachan sunaaeaa |
One distinguishes between the cuckoo and the crow by listening to their voice.
ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਚਾਰਿ, ਸਾਹ ਗਣਾਇਆ ।
khaanee baanee chaar, saah ganaaeaa |
He created the four life-mines and endowed them worthy speech and judiciously gifted breaths.
ਪੰਜਿ ਸਬਦ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ, ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਬਜਾਇਆ ।੫।
panj sabad paravaan, neesaan bajaaeaa |5|
He made the A's accept the five gross varieties of the (subtle) unstuck Word and thus on the beat of drum He pronounced His supremacy over all.
ਪਉੜੀ ੬
paurree 6
ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸੰਬਾਦ, ਗਿਆਨੁ ਚੇਤਾਇਆ ।
raag naad sanbaad, giaan chetaaeaa |
Music, melody, dialogue and knowledge make man a conscious being.
ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਸਾਧਿ, ਸਾਧੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ।
nau daravaaje saadh, saadh sadaaeaa |
By disciplining the nine gates of the body one is called a sadhu.
ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਉਲੰਘਿ, ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ।
veeh ikeeh ulangh, nij ghar aaeaa |
Transcending the worldy illusions he stabilizes within his self.
ਪੂਰਕ ਕੁੰਭਕ ਰੇਚਕ, ਤ੍ਰਾਟਕ ਧਾਇਆ ।
poorak kunbhak rechak, traattak dhaaeaa |
Prior to this, he was running after various practices of hath yoga,
ਨਿਉਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਭੁਯੰਗੁ, ਆਸਣ ਲਾਇਆ ।
niaulee karam bhuyang, aasan laaeaa |
Such as the rechak, purak, kumbhak, tratak, nyolrand bhujarig asan.
ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਝਾਗ, ਸੁਖਮਨਿ ਛਾਇਆ ।
eirraa pingulaa jhaag, sukhaman chhaaeaa |
He practised different processes of breathing like ire', pirigala and susumna.
ਖੇਚਰ ਭੂਚਰ ਚਾਚਰ, ਸਾਧਿ ਸਧਾਇਆ ।
khechar bhoochar chaachar, saadh sadhaaeaa |
He perfected their khechari and chachari postures.
ਸਾਧ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਖੇਲੁ, ਉਨਮਨਿ ਆਇਆ ।੬।
saadh agochar khel, unaman aaeaa |6|
Through such mysterious sport he establishes himself in the equipoise.
ਪਉੜੀ ੭
paurree 7
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸਤੁ ਅੰਗੁਲ ਲੈ, ਮਨੁ ਪਵਣੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ।
trai sat angul lai, man pavan milaaeaa |
The breath going ten fingers out the mind is associated with the vital air the practice is completed.
ਸੋਹੰ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ, ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
sohan sehaj subhaae, alakh lakhaaeaa |
The imperceptible soham (I am He) is ualised in equipoise.
ਨਿਝਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਚੁਆਇ, ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਆਇਆ ।
nijhar dhaar chuaae, apiau peeaeaa |
In this state of equipoise, the rare drink of ever-wing cascade is quaffed.
ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ, ਨਾਦ ਵਜਾਇਆ ।
anahad dhun liv laae, naad vajaaeaa |
Getting absorbed in the unstruck melody a mysterious sound is heard.
ਅਜਪਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਾਇ, ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।
ajapaa jaap japaae, sun samaaeaa |
Through silent prayer, one merges in the Suny (Lord)
ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਇ, ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ।
sun samaadh samaae, aap gavaaeaa |
And in that perfect mental tranquillity egoism is done away with.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਚਖਾਇ, ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ ।
guramukh piram chakhaae, nij ghar chhaaeaa |
The gurmukhs drink from the cup of love and establish themselves in their own real self.
ਗੁਰਸਿਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ, ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ।੭।
gurasikh sandh milaae, pooraa paaeaa |7|
Meeting the Guru, the Sikh achieves the perfect completeness.
ਪਉੜੀ ੮
paurree 8
ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇ, ਦੀਵਾ ਬਾਲਿਆ ।
jotee jot jagaae, deevaa baaliaa |
As the lamp is lit from the flame of another lamp;
ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ, ਵਣਸਪਤਿ ਫਾਲਿਆ ।
chandan vaas nivaas, vanasapat faaliaa |
As sandal's fragrance makes the whole vegetation fragrant
ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ, ਤ੍ਰਿਬੇਣੀ ਚਾਲਿਆ ।
salalai salal sanjog, tribenee chaaliaa |
As the water mixing with water acquires the status of trivevi(the confluence of three rivers - Gatiga; Yamuna and Sarasvati);
ਪਵਣੈ ਪਵਣੁ ਸਮਾਇ, ਅਨਹਦੁ ਭਾਲਿਆ ।
pavanai pavan samaae, anahad bhaaliaa |
As air after meeting the vital air becomes unstruck melody;
ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿ, ਪਰੋਇ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ।
heerai heeraa bedh, paroe dikhaaliaa |
As a diamond being perforated by another diamond gets stringed into a necklace;
ਪਥਰੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ, ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਾਲਿਆ ।
pathar paaras hoe, paaras paaliaa |
A stone by becoming the philosopher's stone performs its feat and
ਅਨਲ ਪੰਖਿ ਪੁਤੁ ਹੋਇ, ਪਿਤਾ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲਿਆ ।
anal pankh put hoe, pitaa samhaaliaa |
As an anil bird getting birth in the sky promotes the work of its father;
ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ, ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਖਾਲਿਆ ।੮।
brahamai braham milaae, sehaj sukhaaliaa |8|
Likewise the Guru making the Sikh meet the Lord establishes him in the equipoise.
ਪਉੜੀ ੯
paurree 9
ਕੇਵਡੁ ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ, ਪਸਾਉ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।
kevadd ik kavaau, pasaau karaaeaa |
How great is His one vibration which has created the whole expanse of the world!
ਕੇਵਡੁ ਕੰਡਾ ਤੋਲੁ, ਤੋਲਿ ਤੁਲਾਇਆ ।
kevadd kanddaa tol, tol tulaaeaa |
How big is His weighing hook that it has sustained the whole creation!
ਕਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕਰੋੜਿ, ਕਵਾਉ ਵਧਾਇਆ ।
kar brahamandd karorr, kavaau vadhaaeaa |
Creating crores of universes He has spread around His power of speech.
ਲਖ ਲਖ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਗਾਸਿ, ਅਧਰ ਧਰਾਇਆ ।
lakh lakh dharat agaas, adhar dharaaeaa |
Lakhs of earths and skies He kept hanging without support.
ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ, ਲਖ ਉਪਾਇਆ ।
paun paanee baisantar, lakh upaaeaa |
Million types of airs, waters and fires He created.
ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੋਨਿ, ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ।
lakh chauraaseeh jon, khel rachaaeaa |
He created the game of eighty four lakhs of species.
ਜੋਨਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ, ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ।
jon jon jeea jant, ant na paaeaa |
No end is known of the creatures of even one species.
ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ, ਅਲੇਖੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ।੯।
sir sir lekh likhaae, alekh dhiaaeaa |9|
He has engraved writ on the forehead of all so that they all meditate upon the Lord who is beyond writ.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦
paurree 10
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ, ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
satigur sachaa naau, aakh sunaaeaa |
The true Guru has recited (to the disciples) the true name.
ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਥਾਉ, ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਾਇਆ ।
gur moorat sach thaau, dhiaan dharaaeaa |
Gurmurati,the word of the Guru is the real object to meditate upon.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਸਰਾਉ, ਸਚਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ।
saadhasangat asaraau, sach suhaaeaa |
The holy congregation is such a refuge where the truth adorns the place.
ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ, ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ।
daragah sach niaau, hukam chalaaeaa |
In the court of the true justice, the order of the Lord prevails.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਗਿਰਾਉ, ਸਬਦ ਵਸਾਇਆ ।
guramukh sach giraau, sabad vasaaeaa |
The village (abode) of the Gurmukhs is the truth which has been habitated with the Word (Sabad).
ਮਿਟਿਆ ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਆਉ, ਗਰੀਬੀ ਛਾਇਆ ।
mittiaa garab guaau, gareebee chhaaeaa |
The ego is decimated there and the (pleasure giving) shade of humility is obtained there.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਹਿਆਉ, ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਾਇਆ ।
guramat sach hiaau, ajar jaraaeaa |
Through the wisdom of Guru (Gurmati) the unbearable truth is instilled into the heart.
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ, ਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ।੧੦।
tis balihaarai jaau, su bhaanaa bhaaeaa |10|
I am sacrifice unto him who loves the Will of the Lord.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧
paurree 11
ਸਚੀ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਇ, ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵਣਾ ।
sachee khasam rajaae, bhaanaa bhaavanaa |
Gurmukhs accept the will of that Lord as truth and they love His will.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ, ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਾ ।
satigur pairee paae, aap gavaavanaa |
Bowing at the feet of the true Guru, they shed their sense of ego.
ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਪਰਚਾਇ, ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਵਣਾ ।
gur chelaa parachaae, man pateeaavanaa |
As disciples, they please the Guru and the heart of the Gum becomes happy.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ, ਨ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਵਣਾ ।
guramukh sehaj subhaae, na alakh lakhaavanaa |
The gurmukh realises the imperceptible Lord spontaneously.
ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਤਿਲ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ, ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ।
gurasikh til na tamaae, kaar kamaavanaa |
The Sikh of Guru has no greed at all and he earns his livelihood by the labour of his hands.
ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ, ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਵਣਾ ।
sabad surat liv laae, hukam manaavanaa |
Merging his consciousness into the word he obeys the commands of the Lord.
ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਲੰਘਾਇ, ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ।
veeh ikeeh langhaae, nij ghar jaavanaa |
Crossing beyond the worldly illusions he abides in his own real self.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ, ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਾ ।੧੧।
guramukh sukh fal paae, sehaj samaavanaa |11|
This way, the gurmukhs having attained the pleasure fruit absorb themselves in equipoise.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨
paurree 12
ਇਕੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਇਕੁ ਸਿਖੁ, ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ।
eik guroo ik sikh, guramukh jaaniaa |
Gurmukhs knew very well about the one Guru (Nanak) and one disciple (Guru Angad).
ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੁ, ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ।
gur chelaa gur sikh, sach samaaniaa |
By becoming the true Sikh of the Guru, this disciple virtually merged himself into the latter.
ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ, ਸਬਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ।
so satigur so sikh, sabad vakhaaniaa |
The true Guru and the disciple were identical (in spirit) and their Word was also one.
ਅਚਰਜ ਭੂਰ ਭਵਿਖ, ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਣਿਆ ।
acharaj bhoor bhavikh, sach suhaaniaa |
This is the wonder of the past and the future that they (both) loved the truth.
ਲੇਖੁ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਅਲਿਖੁ, ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ।
lekh alekh alikh, maan nimaaniaa |
They were beyond all accounts and were honour of the humble ones.
ਸਮਸਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਿਖੁ, ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ ।
samasar amrit vikh, na aavan jaaniaa |
For them, the nectar and poison were the same and they had got liberated from the cycle of transmigration
ਨੀਸਾਣਾ ਹੋਇ ਲਿਖੁ, ਹਦ ਨੀਸਾਣਿਆ ।
neesaanaa hoe likh, had neesaaniaa |
Recorded as the model of special virtues, they are known as the extremely honourable ones.
ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੁ, ਹੋਇ ਹੈਰਾਣਿਆ ।੧੨।
gurasikhahu gur sikh, hoe hairaaniaa |12|
The wonderful fact is that the sikh of the Guru became the Guru.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
paurree 13
ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਪੂਰਿ, ਅਪਿਓ ਪੀਆਵਣਾ ।
piram piaalaa poor, apio peeaavanaa |
Gurmukhs drink the unbearable Cup of love filled to the brims and being in the presence of the all;
ਮਹਰਮੁ ਹਕੁ ਹਜੂਰਿ, ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵਣਾ ।
maharam hak hajoor, alakh lakhaavanaa |
Pervading Lord they perceive the imperceptible.
ਘਟ ਅਵਘਟ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ, ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਵਣਾ ।
ghatt avaghatt bharapoor, ridai samaavanaa |
The one who resides in all hearts is dwelling in their hearts.
ਬੀਅਹੁ ਹੋਇ ਅੰਗੂਰੁ, ਸੁਫਲਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਾ ।
beeahu hoe angoor, sufal samaavanaa |
The love creeper of their's has become full of fruits as the seedling of grape turns out to be fruitful vine.
ਬਾਵਨ ਹੋਇ ਠਰੂਰ, ਮਹਿ ਮਹਿਕਾਵਣਾ ।
baavan hoe ttharoor, meh mahikaavanaa |
Becoming sandal, they provide coolness to one and all.
ਚੰਦਨ ਚੰਦ ਕਪੂਰ, ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਾ ।
chandan chand kapoor, mel milaavanaa |
Their cool is like the coolness of sandal, moon, and camphor.
ਸਸੀਅਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੂਰ, ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਾ ।
saseear andar soor, tapat bujhaavanaa |
Associating the sun (rajas) with the moon (sattv) they assuage its heat.
ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਦੀ ਧੂਰਿ, ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਵਣਾ ।
charan kaval dee dhoor, masatak laavanaa |
They put on their forehead the dust of the lotus feet
ਕਾਰਣ ਲਖ ਅੰਕੂਰ, ਕਰਣੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਾ ।
kaaran lakh ankoor, karan karaavanaa |
And come to know the creator as the root cause of all the causes.
ਵਜਨਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰ, ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਵਣਾ ।੧੩।
vajan anahad toor, jot jagaavanaa |13|
When flame (of knowledge) flashes in their heart, the unstruck melody starts ringing.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
paurree 14
ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ ਅਤੋਲੁ, ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ।
eik kavaau atol, kudarat jaaneeai |
The power of the one vibration of the Lord transcends all limits.
ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਬੋਲੁ, ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੀਐ ।
oankaar abol, choj viddaaneeai |
The wonder and power of Oankft is indescribable.
ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਵ ਅਲੋਲੁ, ਪਾਣੀ ਆਣੀਐ ।
lakh dareeaav alol, paanee aaneeai |
It is with His support that millions of rivers carrying life water go on flowing.
ਹੀਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਅਮੋਲੁ, ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਜਾਣੀਐ ।
heere laal amol, gurasikh jaaneeai |
In His creation, the gurmukhs are known as invaluable diamonds and rubies
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਚਲ ਅਡੋਲ, ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੀਐ ।
guramat achal addol, pat paravaaneeai |
And they remain steadfast in gurmati and are accepted with honour in the court of the Lord.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਰੋਲੁ, ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਣੀਐ ।
guramukh panth nirol, sach suhaaneeai |
The path of the gurmukhs is straight and clear and they reflect the truth.
ਸਾਇਰ ਲਖ ਢੰਢੋਲ, ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੀਐ ।
saaeir lakh dtandtol, sabad neesaaneeai |
Myriad poets desire to know the mystery of His Word.
ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਰਜ ਘੋਲਿ, ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਾਣੀਐ ।
charan kaval raj ghol, amrit vaaneeai |
The gurmukhs have quaffed the dust of the feet of Gum like amrit.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੀਤਾ ਰਜਿ, ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀਐ ।੧੪।
guramukh peetaa raj, akath kahaaneeai |14|
This tale is also ineffable.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫
paurree 15

ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ; ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਖੋਈ ।
pairee pai paa khaak hoe; man bach karam bharam bhau khoee |
The man who by touching the feet and by becoming dust of the feet (of Guru) erases the illusions and fears of speech
ਹੋਇ ਪੰਚਾਇਣੁ ਪੰਜਿ ਮਾਰ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਦਾ ਰਖਿ ਸਗੋਈ ।
hoe panchaaein panj maar; baahar jaadaa rakh sagoee |
And actions from his mind and in the holy congregation wipes out the five evil propensities, he further restrains the mind
ਬੋਲ ਅਬੋਲੁ, ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਓਈ ।੨੧।੨੩। ਤ੍ਰੇਈ ।
bol abol, saadh jan oee |21|23| treee |
Such a one is a real sadhu (Gurmukh) and his words are ineffable.
ਪਉੜੀ ੧
paurree 1
ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਨਿਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਧਰਿ; ਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥ ਸਨਾਥ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।
naaraaein nij roop dhar; naathaa naath sanaath karaaeaa |
Narayan, the lord of the destitutes, assuming forms has established mastery over all.
ਨਰਪਤਿ ਨਰਹ ਨਰਿੰਦੁ ਹੈ; ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ।
narapat narah narind hai; nirankaar aakaar banaaeaa |
He is the formless king of all men and kings who created various forms.
ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ; ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਣੁ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਆ ।
karataa purakh vakhaaneeai; kaaran karan birad biradaaeaa |
As is creator of all the causes He is true to His reputation.
ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾਧਿ ਦੇਵ; ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
devee dev devaadh dev; alakh abhev na alakh lakhaaeaa |
Gods and goddesses also could not know the extent of that Lord, the imperceptible and beyond all mysteries.
ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ਜਪਾਇਆ ।
sat roop sat naam kar; satigur naanak deo japaaeaa |
The ture Guru Nanak Dev inspired people to remember the true name of the Lord whose form is truth.
ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਕਰਤਾਰਪੁਰੁ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚ ਖੰਡੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ।
dharamasaal karataarapur; saadhasangat sach khandd vasaaeaa |
Founding dharamsala, the place for dharma, at Kartarpur, it was inhabited by the holy congregartion as the abode
ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ, ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।੧।
vaahiguroo, gur sabad sunaaeaa |1|
Word Wahiguru was imparted (by Guru Nanak) to the people.
ਪਉੜੀ ੨
paurree 2
ਨਿਹਚਲ ਨੀਉ ਧਰਾਈਓਨੁ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚ ਖੰਡ ਸਮੇਉ ।
nihachal neeo dharaaeeon; saadhasangat sach khandd sameo |
The steadfast foundation of the abode of truth in the form of holy congregation was laid thoughtfully (by Guru Na-nak Dev)
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਚਲਾਇਓਨੁ; ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅਮੇਉ ।
guramukh panth chalaaeon; sukh saagar beant ameo |
And he promulgated gurmukh-panth (Sikhism) which is ocean of infinite pleasures.
ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ; ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ।
sach sabad aaraadheeai; agam agochar alakh abheo |
There, true word is practised which is unapproachable, imperceptible and mystical.
ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾਂ ਉਪਦੇਸਦਾ; ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਸਭਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਉ ।
chahu varanaan upadesadaa; chhia darasan sabh sevak seo |
That abode of truth preaches to all the four varnas and all the six philosophies (of Indian origin) remain absorbed in its service.
ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਨਿਵ ਚਲਣੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਰਥੇਉ ।
mitthaa bolan niv chalan; guramukh bhaau bhagat aratheo |
Gurmukhs (there) speak sweetly, move humbly and are seekers of devotion.
ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹੈ; ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਤਿ ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਉ ।
aad purakh aades hai; abinaasee at achhal achheo |
Salutations are due to that primal Lord who is undestructible, undeceivable and unending.
ਜਗਤੁ ਗੁਰੂ, ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ।੨।
jagat guroo, gur naanak deo |2|
Guru Nanak is the enlightener (Guru) of the entire world.
ਪਉੜੀ ੩
paurree 3
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ; ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਸਹਾਬਾ ।
satigur sachaa paatisaahu; beparavaahu athaahu sahaabaa |
The true Guru is the carefree emperor, unfathomable and full of all qualities of a master.
ਨਾਉ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜੁ ਹੈ; ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜ ਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੁਹਾਬਾ ।
naau gareeb nivaaj hai; bemuhataaj na mohu muhaabaa |
His name is cherisher of the poor; neither He has attachment with any one nor He is dependent on anybody.
ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸਲਾਹ ਸਿਞਾਬਾ ।
besumaar nirankaar hai; alakh apaar salaah siyaabaa |
Formless, infinite and impeceptible, He is having all the attributes which deseve eulogization
ਕਾਇਮੁ ਦਾਇਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੀ; ਹਾਜਰੁ ਨਾਜਰੁ ਵੇਦ ਕਿਤਾਬਾ ।
kaaeim daaeim saahibee; haajar naajar ved kitaabaa |
The mastery of the true Guru is eternal because all the always present before Him (for His praises).
ਅਗਮੁ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਹੈ; ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਡੰਡੀ ਛਾਬਾ ।
agam addol atol hai; tolanahaar na ddanddee chhaabaa |
The true Guru is beyond all measuses; He cannot be weighed on any scale.
ਇਕੁ ਛਤਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਂਵਦਾ; ਦੁਸਮਣੁ ਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਸੋਰ ਸਰਾਬਾ ।
eik chhat raaj kamaanvadaa; dusaman doot na sor saraabaa |
Uniform is His kingdom wherein there is no enemy, no friend and no noisy clamour
ਆਦਲੁ ਅਦਲੁ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ; ਜਾਲਮੁ ਜੁਲਮੁ ਨ ਜੋਰ ਜਰਾਬਾ ।
aadal adal chalaaeidaa; jaalam julam na jor jaraabaa |
The true Guru is judicious; dispenses justice and in His kingdom no atrocity and tyranny is exacted.
ਜਾਹਰ ਪੀਰ, ਜਗਤੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਬਾਬਾ ।੩।
jaahar peer, jagat gur baabaa |3|
Such a grand Guru (Ndnak) is the manifest spiritual teacher of the whole world.
ਪਉੜੀ ੪
paurree 4
ਗੰਗ ਬਨਾਰਸ ਹਿੰਦੂਆਂ; ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣਾਂ ਮਕਾ ਕਾਬਾ ।
gang banaaras hindooaan; musalamaanaan makaa kaabaa |
Hindus adore Ganges and Banaras and Muslims consider Mecca-Kaba as a holy place.But to the accompaniment of mradarig (drum) and rabad (stringed instrument) the praises (of Baba Nanak) are sung
ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਬਾ ਗਾਵੀਐ; ਵਜਨਿ ਤਾਲ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗੁ ਰਬਾਬਾ ।
ghar ghar baabaa gaaveeai; vajan taal mridang rabaabaa |
Lover of the devotees, he has come to uplift the down trodden ones.
ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਆ; ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਅਜਬੁ ਅਜਾਬਾ ।
bhagat vachhal hoe aaeaa; patit udhaaran ajab ajaabaa |
He himfelf is wonderful (because in spite of his powers he is egoless).
ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਹੋਇ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਰਾਬਾ ।
chaar varan ik varan hoe; saadhasangat mil hoe taraabaa |
By his efforts all the four varnas have become one and now the individual gets liberated in the holy congregatio
ਚੰਦਨੁ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ; ਅਵਲਿ ਦੋਮ ਨ ਸੇਮ ਖਰਾਬਾ ।
chandan vaas vanaasapat; aval dom na sem kharaabaa |
Like the fragrant of sandal, he without any discrimination makes every one fragrant.
ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਿਸ ਦੀ ਕਰੈ ਜਵਾਬਾ ।
hukamai andar sabh ko; kudarat kis dee karai javaabaa |
All act as ordained by him and no one has the power to say no to him.
ਜਾਹਰ ਪੀਰੁ, ਜਗਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਬਾ ।੪।
jaahar peer, jagat gur baabaa |4|
Such grand Guru (Nanak) is the manifest spiritual teacher of the whole world.
ਪਉੜੀ ੫
paurree 5
ਅੰਗਹੁ ਅੰਗੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ; ਗੰਗਹੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਤਰੰਗੁ ਉਠਾਇਆ ।
angahu ang upaaeon; gangahu jaan tarang utthaaeaa |
Guru Nanak created him ( Guru Angad) from his limbs as the waves are produced by Ganges out of itself.

gahir ganbheer gaheer gun; guramukh gur gobind sadaaeaa |
Embodied with deep and sublime attributes he (Angad) was known by gurmukhs as the form of the (imperceptible) supreme soul (paramatman).
ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਣਿਹਾਰੁ; ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਆ ।
dukh sukh daataa denihaar; dukh sukh samasar lep na laaeaa |
He himself is bestower of pleasures and pains but remains always without any blot.

gur chelaa, chelaa guroo; gur chele parachaa parachaaeaa |
The love between the Guru and the disciple was such that the disciple became Guru and the Guru disciple.
ਬਿਰਖਹੁ ਫਲੁ, ਫਲ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਖੁ; ਪਿਉ ਪੁਤਹੁ ਪੁਤੁ ਪਿਉ ਪਤੀਆਇਆ ।
birakhahu fal, fal te birakh; piau putahu put piau pateeaeaa |
It happened in the same manner as tree creates fruit and from fruit is created tree, or as father becomes happy over son and son feels happy in obeying the orders of father.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
paarabraham pooran braham; sabad surat liv alakh lakhaaeaa |
His consiconsness merged into word and the perfect transcendental Brahm made him see the imperceptible (Lord).
ਬਾਬਾਣੇ, ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦ ਆਇਆ ।੫।
baabaane, gur angad aaeaa |5|
Now Guru Angad got established as ( the extended form of) Baba Nanak.
ਪਉੜੀ ੬

chandan hoeaa chandanahu; gur upades rehat vich rahanaa |
Living according to the preachings and code of conduct laid down by the Guru, he became sandal by meeting the sandal (Guru Nanak).

jot samaanee jot vich; guramat sukh duramat dukh dahanaa |
The light immersed in the light; the delight of the wisdom of Guru (gurmat) was attained and the sufferings of evil mindedness got burnt and wiped out.

acharaj no acharaj milai; visamaadai visamaad samahanaa |
The wonder met the wonder and becoming wondrous got imbued with the wonder (Guru Nanak).

apiau peean nijhar jharan; ajar jaran asaheean sahanaa |

sach samaanaa sach vich; gaaddee raahu saadhasang vahanaa |
Moving on the highway of the holy congregation, the truth has merged into the truth.
ਬਾਬਾਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ, ਲਹਣਾ ।੬।
baabaanai ghar chaanan, lahanaa |6|
In fact Lahana became the light of Baba Nanak's house.
ਪਉੜੀ ੭
paurree 7

sabadai sabad milaaeaa; guramukh agharr gharraae gahanaa |
Gurumukh (Angad) attuning his sabad (word) to the Sabad has chiselled his clumsy mind to make it an ornament.

bhaae bhagat bhai chalanaa; aap ganaae na khalahal khahanaa |

deen dunee dee saahibee; guramukh gos naseenee bahanaa |

kaaran karan samarath hai; hoe achhal chhal andar chhahanaa |

sat santokh deaa dharam; arath veechaar sehaj ghar ghahanaa |
Dopting truth, contentment, compassion dharma, richness and scriminatory wisdom(Vichar) he has made peace his abo

kaam krodh virodh chhadd; lobh mohu ahankaarahu tahanaa |
Shedding lust, anger and opposition he has repudiated greed, infatuation and ego.

put saput, babaane lahanaa |7|
Such a worthy son Lahana (Angad) is born in the family of Baba (Nanak).
ਪਉੜੀ ੮
paurree 8

gur angad gur ang te; amrit birakh amrit fal faliaa |
From the limb of Guru (Nanak) the tree of nector fruits in the name of Guru Angad has flourished.

jotee jot jagaaeean; deeve te jiau deevaa baliaa |

heerai heeraa bedhiaa; chhal kar achhalee achhal chhaliaa |

koe bujh na hanghee; paanee andar paanee raliaa |
Now they connot be distinguished as if water has mingled with water.

sachaa sach suhaavarraa; sach andar sach sachahu dtaliaa |
The Truth is always beautiful and in the die of truth he (Guru Angad) has moulded himself.

His throne is immovable and kingdom everlasting ; they connot be moved in spite of efforts.

sach sabad gur saupiaa; sach ttakasaalahu sikaa chaliaa |

sidh naath avataar sabh; hath jorr kai hoe khaliaa |
Now siddhs naths and incarnations (of gods) etc have stood before him with folded hands

sachaa hukam su attal, na ttaliaa |8|
And this command is true,immutable and inevitable.

saadhasangat aaraadhiaa; bhagat vachhal hoe achhal chhalaaeaa |

ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ, ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ।੧।

The sadhus adore the Lord in the form of the Guru's feet.
ਪਉੜੀ ੨
paurree 2

guramat nihachal chit kar; sukh sanpatt vich nij ghar chhaaeaa |

Touching the philosopher's stone in the form of the Guru , he repudiating the wealth and physical body of others remains detached from all.

For curing his chronic maladies (of evil propensities) he goes to the holy congregation.

paurree 3

Attainer of the pleasure fruit, the gurmukh lives steadfastly like the pole star in the sky.
